bestowals.vote_detail: Players and Pawns won over Juggernaut, Til Death and D4TC; the presenter, Sanchis Su Idolo, walked off with the trophy.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): the presenter opens the envelope, reads “Players & Pawns!?” and the scene closes “Winner: Players and Pawns.” The winner is a card, not a wrestler, so no recipient is filed. His own biography card lists it among his Fed Awards, wryly: “PPV of the Year(well, okay, he STOLE the award…)” (/promotions/action-2002/archive/sanchissu-idolo-action-2002-bio.html).

bestowals.vote_detail: Cylear's return at Last Laugh, over the Objection/Erection birth, the Scout Hat confrontation and The Truth Is Told.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): the presenter opens the envelope — “And the winner of this award is… Sean Cylear’s return to Action!” — Cylear accepts in a speech and the scene closes “Winner: Sean Cylear.” The nominations are four clips, not persons.

bestowals.vote_detail: Nominated: Coral Avalon, Max Danger, Keith Scott Zimmerman and Conrad Ramsey.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): “And the winner is, drum roll please… MAX DANGER!” and the scene closes “Winner: Max Danger.” The scene's header names four nominees and the voice-over reads six (adding Jeff Garvin and Bobby Minio); both are as it stands.

bestowals.vote_detail: “LLB's Not a Lawyer” (Blood, Sweat, Tears) over Keri's turn on her husband, Cylear's return and KroW leaving.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): “And the winner is… LLB’s not a lawyer!” LLB accepts and the scene closes “Winner: LLB.” The award is for the moment; it is filed to LLB, who stands at its centre and accepts it.

bestowals.vote_detail: Nominated: Joey Malone, LLB, The Elements and Simon Seaman.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): “Action Wrestling’s best Champion thus far… LLB.” and the scene closes “Winner: LLB.”

bestowals.vote_detail: Nominated: Keri Lindum, Reed Young, Siobhan Tyler and Pikachu.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): the envelope is opened — “And the winner iiissssss… Um. Keri Lindum slash Malone?” — and the scene closes “Winner: Keri Lindum.” Her own card gives the year as “Manager of the Year(2002-2003)” (/promotions/action-2002/archive/keri-lindum-action-2002-bio.html); the ceremony itself is the first annual one, filed under 2002.

bestowals.vote_detail: Announced for LLB's Erroneous Conclusion; both men walked up and LLB handed Coral Avalon the trophy.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): the envelope names “The ‘Erroneous Conclusion’!”, LLB and Coral Avalon both come to the stage, LLB says “but I’m the winner of the move” and hands Avalon the award, and the results line reads “Winner: LLB and Coral Avalon?” Filed as a shared award, in that order.

bestowals.vote_detail: Nominated: Joey Malone, LLB, Coral Avalon and Christopher Fox.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): a guest presenter opens the sheet — “The winner is… Christopher Fox…” — and the scene closes “Winner: Christopher Fox.” His own card reads “Top Face 2002-2003” (/promotions/action-2002/archive/christopher-fox-action-2002-bio.html).

bestowals.vote_detail: Nominated: Jeff Garvin, LLB, Max Danger and Syphon Fission.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): “The winner is Jeff Garvin.” and the scene closes “Winner: Jeff Garvin.” His own card reads “A! Heel of the Year” (/promotions/action-2002/archive/jeff-garvin-bio.html).

bestowals.vote_detail: Joey Malone and Syphon Fission, over LLB/KroW, Malone/Kent Anthason and LLB/Christopher Fox.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): “Joey Malone and Syphon Fission!” and the scene closes “Winners: Joey Malone & Syphon Fission.” Malone's card reads “Feud of the Year(w/ Fission)” and Fission's “2003 Feud of the Year(w/Joey Malone)” — his card's year differs from the ceremony's first annual year, and both are as written (/promotions/action-2002/archive/joey-malone-action-2002-bio.html; /promotions/action-2002/archive/syphon-fission-action-2002-bio.html).

bestowals.vote_detail: Three named for enrolment in the Ring of Gold, the company's own hall of fame, once they retire from it.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): “The Ring of Gold Nominees are Joey Malone, LLB, and Christopher Fox.” and the scene closes “Nominated: Joey Malone, LLB & Christopher Fox.” The scene itself says the three would be up for enrolment “when retired from AW”; this is a nomination for a later honour, not an induction, and none is filed.

bestowals.vote_detail: Nominated: Reed Young, Jeremy Bold, Pringles the Puppy and a joke nominee.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): the envelope is opened and the winner is “my daddy, Reed Young”, the presenter being his son; the scene closes “Winner: Reed Young.” His own card reads “Owner of the best, Fed, EEEVVVEEERRR!!” (/promotions/action-2002/archive/reed-young-action-2002-bio.html).

bestowals.vote_detail: Nominated: Winds of Change, Clit 'N Candy, Pretty Fly and The Elements; Action! Team accepted for them.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): “And the winners are… the Elements!”, the team not being present, and the scene closes “Winners: The Elements.”

bestowals.vote_detail: The Iron Man Match, Coral Avalon vs Jeff Garvin at Players and Pawns, over seven other nominated matches.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): “…And the winner’s ARE… CORAL AVALON! JEFF GARVIN! THE IRON MAN MATCH!” and the scene closes “Winners: Coral Avalon & Jeff Garvin.” Their own cards read “Match of the Year(vs. Jeff Garvin @ Players & Pawns)” and “A! Match of the Year (w/ Coral Avalon)” (/promotions/action-2002/archive/coral-avalon-acw-bio.html; /promotions/action-2002/archive/jeff-garvin-bio.html).

bestowals.vote_detail: Nominated: LLB, Christopher Fox, Joey Malone and Airborn Tyler.
bestowals.source: Action Wrestling's own Action! Awards of 13 March 2003, its first annual ceremony (/promotions/action-2002/archive/action-2002-the-action-awards-2003-2003-03-13.html): “And this year’s wrestler of the year… the very first in Action Wrestling… Joey Malone.” and the scene closes “Winner: Joey Malone.” His own card reads “Wrestler of the Year” (/promotions/action-2002/archive/joey-malone-action-2002-bio.html).
